config.task: y = w·x + 0.15·Σ x_i·x_(i+1 mod 10), x ~ N(0,1)^10 (linear + cyclic pair interactions)

arms.fibonacci_recurrence: X0 = tanh(W0 x + b0); shared f(v) = F v + bf; X_{k+2} = tanh(f(X_{k+1}) + X_k), k = 0..2; y = wr·X3 + br; 115 params (shared F applied 3x)

config.training: true full-batch GD (gradient accumulated over all training samples per step, single update), MSE, identical schedule and init distributions for both arms
config.verdict_rule: adopt iff the recurrence beats the MLP on test RMSE for ALL 3 seeds; otherwise reject. Passed = an explicit verdict with documented margin (P8).

verdict_note: recurrence beats MLP on all 3 seeds (mean relative improvement +6.87%)
